# SpikingObjectLocalization

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A technique for identifying and bounding objects using spike-based representations, often relying on temporal accumulation of spikes to refine spatial predictions. Demonstrates how spike-timing can be exploited for robust object detection, advancing neuromorphic vision beyond static frame-based methods.
